sentences.en: In the corner of the square, the opposing forces' gazes were fixed intently on the stage. Shirogane and Kogayama stood a short distance apart, watching the governor's glamorous announcement with bitter feelings. For them, who were consumed by the struggle for budgets and positions, Akatsuka's flashy project was hardly amusing. Shirogane let out a thin smile and muttered in a low voice to his subordinate. To the eyes of a man skilled at reading the winds of public opinion, this ceremony appeared to be nothing more than a calculated show. Beside him, Kogayama lowered his gaze to the materials at hand and quietly conveyed the background of the new organization's chief doctor. sentences.en: When the MER arrived at the accident scene, Governor Akatsuka was already present in the garage. Having made a special trip from the metropolitan government office, she was accompanied by Takanawa as a political associate. Akatsuka briefly offered a word of appreciation and quickly noticed the presence of Otowa standing behind her.
